notes: «8ـ» is a number. «عَنْهُ» at the start refers back to the previous report's last teacher (back_reference). «رَفَعُوهُ إِلَى» means the chain was raised to the Imam. The Imam's father «أَبِي» (his prayer is the subject of the matn) is not a link here, since he is named as the subject of the prayer and not as a transmitter.
